blocks.text: ILOILO CITY — Capiz Gov. Fredenil Castro has ordered the creation of a provincial El Niño Task Force and given it 15 days to prepare an action plan to address potential water shortages, agricultural losses and health risks caused by prolonged dry spells. Under Executive Order No. 31, signed Oct. 21, 2026, the task force will coordinate preparedness and mitigation measures across Capiz’s 16 municipalities and Roxas City. Castro will chair the task force, with the provincial administrator as vice chairperson and executive coordinator. The Provincial Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (PDRRMO) will lead operations and serve as the secretariat. […]...
